snippet.title: Fableborne Season 4 is here! (NEW Mobile Game DEC 2025)
snippet.description:
Fableborne is a mobile-first, free-to-play multiplayer game combining strategic base building with high-intensity ARPG raiding.

Test your skills in asynchronous PvP raiding against other raiders, battle through the campaign, or even try your best in PvE challenge modes. 

New in Fableborne Season 4:
Our fourth main hero, Ember. 
Fableborne Guilds and social play
Hero Ascendency and Ability Tomes
Bounties and Chests 
New defense units..
And more! 

Fableborne Season 4 goes live on both Android and iOS on December 2nd 2025! We hope to see you there! 


Make sure to join our community and follow us on Social Media to stay up to date!

Discord:  https://fableborne.com/discord
Website: https://fableborne.com
Medium: https://fableborne.com/medium
Twitter: https://fableborne.com/twitter
Telegram: https://fableborne.com/telegram

Let’s embark on an exciting journey together, let’s #becomefableborne.


Fableborne is developed by Pixion Games, a London-based studio building competitive mobile-first experiences, that are accessible for everyone in bitesize sessions.

Pixion Games is home to veterans from Konami, Garena, Gala Games, Square Enix, Sony, Wargaming, Pixonic, Ubisoft, NCSOFT and many other world’s most formidable game studios, with a proven track record in developing multiplayer experiences for millions of players.
